description.ja: DeepSeek AIのMixture-of-Experts（MoE）アーキテクチャ実証モデル。2024年1月11日公開。細粒度エキスパート分割と共有エキスパート分離という革新的技術を導入。16Bの総パラメータで27億のみ活性化し、7B Denseモデルに匹敵する性能を実現。後のV2、V3シリーズの基盤となるアーキテクチャ。
description.en: DeepSeek AI's Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture demonstration model. Released January 11, 2024. Introduces innovative fine-grained expert segmentation and shared expert isolation techniques. With 16B total parameters activating only 2.7B, achieves performance comparable to 7B dense models. Foundation architecture for later V2 and V3 series.

specs.architecture: Sparse MoE, Fine-grained expert segmentation, Shared expert isolation, Always-active shared experts + routed experts, Reduced knowledge redundancy

description.ja: 16B総パラメータ、27億活性化。7B Denseモデル相当の性能を27億の活性化パラメータで実現。
description.en: 16B total, 2.7B active parameters. Achieves 7B dense model performance with only 2.7B active parameters.

requirements.notes: INT4: 10GB (loads full model but activates only 2.7B)
